comment: The signal input and the four outputs carry whatever you patch in, so they are given no family. sumRange for the ROUTE CV input is written as a voltage range because the field takes only those four spellings; the quantity it clamps is the 0-to-1 routing position, not a voltage. The crossfade law is a cubic in gainsForChannels (src/plugin.cpp:20-27) with per-channel gains of 0.89, 0.865, 0.865 and 0.89; outputs 1 and 4 are clamped at their outer ends so the routing does not wrap. The maker's own second-line descriptions on the two inputs read 'Normalized to 10V' and 'Expects 5V peak-to-peak, combines with ROUTE slider', and both are borne out by the code.
